overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a board member's questions and comments at a Finance Committee meeting were openly directed to the Committee and did not amount to Board deliberation, even with a quorum present.

allegations.summary: Alleged the Select Board deliberated at a May 5 Finance Committee meeting, where a board member spoke in person and another attended by Zoom, forming a quorum.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the specific facts of this case, we find that Ms. Kell’s questions and comments during the Committee’s May 5 meeting did not constitute deliberation by the Board despite there being a quorum of the Board in attendance.
